news.headline: Zacks Research Upgrades Delcath Systems to Strong-Buy
news.summary: Zacks Research upgraded DCTH from Hold to Strong-Buy following the Q2 beat and raised guidance. The upgrade came alongside the stock's push to fresh 52-week highs.

news.headline: Delcath Systems Sets New 52-Week High
news.summary: DCTH shares traded as high as roughly $17.42, a new 52-week high, extending the post-earnings rally. The move followed the Q2 revenue beat and raised full-year guidance.

news.headline: Delcath Systems Presents at Canaccord Genuity 46th Annual Growth Conference
news.summary: Delcath management presented a corporate update to investors in Boston, reiterating HEPZATO KIT commercial momentum and center-expansion plans.

news.headline: H.C. Wainwright Raises Delcath Price Target to $32 from $30
news.summary: H.C. Wainwright reiterated its Buy rating and lifted its price target to $32, citing HEPZATO demand momentum; several other brokerages also raised targets after the Q2 print (BTIG to $21).

news.headline: Delcath Systems Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results, Raises Full-Year Guidance
news.summary: Delcath reported Q2 2026 revenue of $29.1 million, up 20% year-over-year (HEPZATO KIT revenue $27.1 million, up ~30% in volume), with 90% gross margin and net income of $2.7 million. Management raised full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $104-108 million and reiterated expectations for positive adjusted EBITDA for the year.

news.headline: New Data at ESMO Breast Cancer 2026 Show 60% Hepatic Response Rate with Percutaneous Hepatic Perfusion
news.summary: Independent investigators presented retrospective data at ESMO Breast Cancer 2026 showing a 60% hepatic partial response rate using melphalan percutaneous hepatic perfusion in heavily pretreated liver-dominant metastatic breast cancer patients, supporting the ongoing Phase 2 breast cancer program.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: Delcath's next scheduled quarterly results release; date not yet formally announced.

catalysts.label: Additional HEPZATO treatment center activations
catalysts.detail: Company plans to continue expanding its network of active HEPZATO KIT treatment centers (31+ as of Q2 2026) to support raised FY2026 volume guidance.

catalysts.label: Phase 2 mCRC hepatic-PFS readout
catalysts.detail: Hepatic progression-free survival data expected from the Phase 2 trial of HEPZATO in liver-dominant metastatic colorectal cancer, combined with standard of care.

pulse: Delcath continues to execute on strong commercial momentum for HEPZATO KIT, with Q2 2026 revenue up 20% year-over-year, raised FY2026 guidance to $104-108 million, and shares hitting fresh 52-week highs above $17 in mid-August on a wave of analyst price-target increases (H.C. Wainwright to $32, others following). No major new catalysts or setbacks have emerged since the mid-August highs; the stock is consolidating gains from the Q2 beat and ESMO breast cancer data while the market awaits further center activations and the next quarterly print (~November).
